ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all founding members, managers, 10%+ shareholders and every 25%+ UBO against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI List, and Egyptian national terrorist lists published in the Official Gazette under the Anti-Terrorism Law No. 94 of 2015. PEP determination is required for domestic and foreign public-office holders, their family members and close associates; foreign-PEP status triggers senior-management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, and enhanced ongoing monitoring under EMLCU and CBE rules. Standard CDD applies for the Low-Risk Standard tier of the ISIC 2750 robotic appliance manufacturing scope; simplified due diligence is unavailable where any UBO remains non-resident or acts through a corporate nominee.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic Services Portal - General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (www.gafi.gov.eg) together with the Commercial Registry Office operating under the Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; tax-related registration is handled separately through the Egyptian Tax Authority e-portal (www.incometax.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The LLC name must be formulated in Arabic script and must incorporate the legal-form designation. Foreign trade names are admissible only in phonetic Arabic transliteration; the Latin-script variant may appear in the English version of the Memorandum of Association but does not constitute the registered name. The name must not be misleading, must not exceed the regulated character limit, and must not create confusion with an existing registered company or with a well-known trademark protected in Egypt.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Insurance, Securities, Trust, Fiduciary (exclusive financial-sector terms requiring prior CBE or FRA licensing)
Central, National, State, Government, Sovereign (potentially implying official sponsorship; ministerial clearance required)
Islamic, Arab, International, Gulf, Egyptian (require prior ministerial or competent-authority approval)
Defence, Military, Police, Security-Forces (contrary to public order unless authorised by the Ministry of Interior)
Names identical or confusingly similar to a registered Egyptian company or a protected foreign trademark
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, GAFI issues a reasoned refusal notice. The applicant may (i) file an internal administrative grievance with the Chairman of GAFI within 30 days, attaching evidence of distinctiveness such as a trademark registration or prior-use proof; (ii) submit a revised name application without additional search fees; and (iii) after exhaustion of administrative remedies, challenge the refusal before the Administrative Court (State Council) within 60 days of the grievance decision. The initial reservation is valid for 30 days and may be renewed once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the statutory renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office. For a manufacturing LLC under ISIC 2750, Egyptian law and GAFI practice require a physical place of business in Egypt evidenced by a lease or title deed; a virtual-office address may only supplement, and never replace, the registered manufacturing or warehouse premises. The notarial deed of incorporation must state a real governorate address, and a P.O. Box alone is rejected.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 30% probability of an unannounced GAFI / Commercial Registry verification visit within the first 12 months after registration. For the industrial licence phase, the Industrial Development Authority together with labour and environmental inspectorates conduct on-site audits with an estimated 45-50% probability during the first two years of operation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 159 of 1981 (Egyptian Companies Law), as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018, together with its Executive Regulations; applicable sections relating to the formation, share capital, managers, and governance of limited liability companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration Directorate, Cairo, Egypt
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued by GAFI upon endorsement of the Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Egyptian law; however, the declared share capital must be sufficient for the stated purpose, and cash contributions must be deposited in a segregated Egyptian bank account in the company's name before filing; in-kind capital contributions require a certified valuation report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF [DATE]. RESOLVED, that: 1. The Articles of Association are adopted, and each incorporator irrevocably subscribes to the authorised share capital of the Company. 2. The registered office is fixed at [address], Cairo Governorate. 3. The corporate purpose includes manufacturing, assembling, and selling autonomous robotic vacuum cleaners. 4. [Name] and [Name] are appointed as Joint Managers. 5. The Joint Managers are authorised to open corporate bank accounts, sign contracts, and pursue all permits, including environmental and industrial licenses. 6. This resolution shall take effect from this date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade Name Reservation and Corporate Dossier Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit in person or through the GAFI portal the LLC registration application with three proposed trade names in order of preference. Pay the designation fee and obtain the name reservation certificate. Ensure that the proposed name does not conflict with existing marks or prohibited religious/social phrases.
required_dossiers: Completed GAFI incorporation application form
Three proposed trade names in priority order
Passport or national ID copy of the applicant
Payment receipt for name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or regulatory grounds, the applicant may promptly resubmit using the second or third proposed name; no administrative appeal is needed for name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarisation of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Department, Egyptian Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in Arabic (or bilingual Arabic/English) and present them to the Notary Public together with the name reservation certificate and identity documents. All founding shareholders or their legal authorized representatives must sign before the notary. The notary authenticates the signatures and returns certified copies.
required_dossiers: Notarially drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association
Trade name reservation certificate
Valid passport or national ID of each shareholder and manager
Notarized power of attorney if a representative signs
Corporate documents and authorization for institutional shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries the draft, the attorney may amend the defective clauses, re-sign before the notary, and re-submit; no penalty applies for a first amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital deposit bank account in the company's name with the selected Egyptian bank. Deposit the agreed cash share capital or, for non-cash contributions, deliver the in-kind valuation report. Obtain the bank certificate confirming receipt of capital deposits for submission to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Shareholder subscription list and capital schedule
Passport copies and bank account information of shareholders
Official valuation report for in-kind contributions, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects due to KYC deficiencies, supply corrected beneficiary documents and clear evidence of source of funds; then request a fresh capital certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation application with GAFI, including the notarized Articles of Association, capital deposit certificate, and name reservation certificate. Pay the prescribed government filing and stamp fees. GAFI reviews the file for legal compliance, registers the LLC in the electronic commercial registry, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Incorporation application addressed to GAFI
Original and two certified copies of Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Trade name reservation certificate
Certified copies of shareholder/manager identity documents
Criminal record certificates for managers where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues an objection, obtain the written reasons, rectify omissions within the legal cure period, and resubmit; repeated rejection may be appealed to the GAFI internal grievances committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication, Tax Registration, and Commercial Registry Completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI for Official Gazette publication; Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Supply; Egyptian Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, publish the company summary in the Official Gazette, finalize the commercial registry entry, obtain the Tax Identification Card and Value Added Tax certificate, and register with the Social Insurance Organization where applicable. These post-incorporation filings are mandatory for operational commencement.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial registration form
Proof of registered office address
Bank certificate and Articles of Association
Lease or ownership deed of the operational premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry or Tax Authority delays the certificate, file a formal follow-up request and suspended delivery letter; any identified deficiency can be cured by amending the registration particulars and resubmitting same-day.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) under the Egyptian Ministry of Trade and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License under Law No. 15 of 2017 (Industrial Licensing Law)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) under the Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Limited Environmental Impact Assessment / Environmental Scoping for assembly of small electrical appliances and light manufacturing; full EIA may be required for integrated metal finishing or spray painting lines.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994, as amended; wastewater discharges to public sewer must meet applicable EEAA tables for pH (6–9), BOD, COD, TSS, oil and grease, and heavy metals; airborne VOCs from soldering, adhesives, and cleaning agents must be kept within occupational ambient limits; hazardous wastes such as batteries and electronic components must be segregated, labelled, and sent to licensed handlers under an approved waste manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate from the Civil Defense Authority approving firefighting equipment and evacuation plan; structural load inspection and building clearance from the local municipality / planning authority; and occupational safety and health registration with the Ministry of Manpower covering workspace safety, protective equipment, and incident prevention protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; unified tax administration and e-services via https://www.eta.gov.eg and the e-invoicing platform https://www.invoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned LLCs must open an ETA tax file and obtain a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) covering CIT, VAT, WHT and stamp duty. Procedure: (1) incorporate with GAFI under Companies Law 159/1981 and Investment Law 72/2017 (no minimum capital, 100% foreign ownership permitted) and obtain the Commercial Register extract; (2) before or promptly upon commencement, in any event within 30 days of incorporation/commencement, file the ETA registration application at the competent tax office (Mamouria), attaching the commercial register, certified and Arabic-notarized constitutional documents of the foreign parent, power of attorney, managers' passports, and proof of Egyptian registered premises; (3) ETA issues the unified TIN valid for all taxes; (4) register for VAT within the statutory deadline after exceeding the EGP 500,000 annual threshold; (5) complete e-invoicing activation and certification of the API/SFTP clearance channel before issuing invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - an Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person taxed at entity level on worldwide income at 22.5% standard CIT (Law 91/2005 as amended); no pass-through default exists; SCZone and free-zone incentives apply only via separate license.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt has no check-the-box or pass-through election; LLC status is mandatorily taxable at entity level. Available elections: (1) consolidated group taxation for resident companies with 90% or greater direct/indirect ownership (ETA advance approval required); (2) small-supplier simplified VAT accounting for turnovers below the registration threshold; (3) depreciation and inventory method elections made with the first return and changeable only with ETA consent; (4) advance pricing/ruling application for tax classification and transfer-pricing treatment; (5) no unilateral hybrid mismatch election - Egypt applies its domestic rules and the BEPS MLI principal-purpose test.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory VAT registration threshold); voluntary registration available below the threshold in accordance with ETA rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory clearance-based e-invoicing under ETA Decision 444/2021 and successive phasing: VAT-registered taxpayers must transmit each tax invoice to the ETA platform in XML/JSON via web portal, SFTP or certified API within 24 hours of issuance; ETA validates in near real time and issues a UUID plus QR code digitally stamping the invoice before legal effect; unstamped invoices are void and disallow input VAT recovery. The e-receipt (coded receipt) mandate is phased in for B2C sales of household electrical appliances, requiring near-real-time encrypted transmission from certified cash registers or POS software.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supplier may claim 0% VAT on: (1) goods physically exported from Egypt with customs exit and transfer of title to a non-resident; (2) services supplied to non-residents where the place of supply is Egypt but the benefit is enjoyed outside Egypt, including services directly related to exported goods; and (3) goods placed in free zones for export. The exporter must prove actual export via customs records, contract, invoices and CBE-compliant receipt of proceeds; input VAT attributable to zero-rated exports remains creditable and is refundable through ETA's VAT refund dossier.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audits every export zero-rating claim by cross-matching the Customs Authority export declaration (Ashal platform) with the bank FX remittance certificate; documentary gaps or delayed remittances trigger reassessment at the standard 14% rate with a 2% monthly late-payment surcharge and 5-year retroactive assessment. Fraudulent or sham export documentation subjects the exporter to clawback of all refunded VAT, administrative penalties and surcharges under Law 188/2022 (TAFITA), suspension of e-invoicing and export clearance privileges, public blacklisting by ETA/customs, and criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to 5 years and/or fines up to EGP 10 million.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE; Al-Bank al-Markazi al-Masri) under Law No. 194 of 2020, acting through its Banking Operations Sector, Foreign Relations Sector, and the CBE Foreign-Exchange Committee; the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) coordinates investment-related FX documentation for foreign-owned LLCs.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current-account transactions (trade in goods, services, freight, and audited profit dividends) are freely convertible at the unified interbank EGP/USD rate following the March 2024 managed-float reform under the IMF Extended Fund Facility; no prior CBE license is required for bona fide trade remittances. Capital-account flows (foreign equity subscription, intercompany shareholder loans, portfolio inflows, and FX hedging premiums) remain document-intensive: the receiving bank must verify the LLC's GAFI registration file, classify the flow under Egypt's BPM6-based reporting framework, and issue a CBE capital-entry certificate (Shahadat Dukhul Ra's Al-Mal) for eventual repatriation. Profit-remittance friction is moderate: dividends require IFRS-compliant audited financial statements, general-assembly minutes, and an Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) tax-clearance certificate; no separate CBE exchange-control approval is required once the bank's documentary file is complete. If the LLC were instead licensed within the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE), additional FX waiver regimes and zone-escrow account structures would apply; the present blueprint is built on a standard onshore LLC basis.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The pre-2024 mandatory export-proceeds surrender regime (historically 50-100% conversion at the official rate) has been repealed: since April 2024 EG_LLC may retain 100% of USD export receipts in its foreign-currency account. The statutory repatriation window nonetheless applies: proceeds from non-oil manufactured exports (ISIC 2750 robotic floor-cleaning appliances) must be credited to an Egyptian bank account within 30 calendar days of the transport-document date, extendable to 180 days for capital goods with prior bank approval. The receiving bank must match each receipt with the corresponding Egyptian customs export declaration submitted through the National Single Window (NAFEZA/AFSIS) and report the transaction to the CBE; late repatriation attracts fines and possible suspension of the exporter's commercial-registry file.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Paid-up Capital Escrow Account / Corporate EGP Operating Account / USD Foreign-Currency Account (FCA)
Paid-up Capital Deposit Account / Corporate EGP + USD Transaction Account / Trade Finance LC Lines
Capital Escrow Account / EGP Operating Account / USD FCA / Import LC and Export Receivable Discounting Facility
Capital Escrow Account / Multi-Currency EGP-USD-EUR Account / Global Cross-Border Treasury Hub
Capital Escrow Account / EGP + USD Current Account / Structured FX Dealer

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW for primary treasury operations. Foreign digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, 3S Money) are not licensed by the CBE under Law No. 194 of 2020 as banks or payment institutions; they cannot hold EGP accounts, issue Egyptian IBANs, settle local trade, or lawfully receive export proceeds on behalf of an Egyptian exporter without breaching CBE export-repatriation reporting. Legally permissible ancillary deployment is limited to offshore concentration accounts for non-Egyptian supplier payments invoiced in USD/CNH, provided the underlying import settlement into Egypt clears through a licensed Egyptian correspondent bank and the EMI does not intermediate any customer-facing Egyptian payment relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for the Egyptian-resident authorized signatory (normally the LLC's general manager or appointed finance director) at the account-opening interview at a bank branch in Egypt; corporate remote/online onboarding is not permitted under CBE AML/CFT rules. Non-resident shareholders and directors may execute the account-opening resolution and power of attorney remotely, but the POA must be notarized in the home jurisdiction and legalized by the Egyptian consulate or, where applicable, apostilled under Egypt's accession to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. The locally resident signatory must present an original passport, commercial-registry extract issued within three months, current tax card, and proof of address; banks also require a live in-branch signature specimen and UBO declaration (all shareholders holding 25% or more).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Major red flag: 100% non-resident foreign ownership of EG_LLC with no prior Egyptian banking relationship, combined with projected annual USD export proceeds above EGP 250 million and heavy supplier concentration in PRC/HK markets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate; LLC incorporation certificate under Companies Law No. 4 of 2022; articles of association with UBO annex; passports and source-of-wealth declarations for all shareholders; home-country bank reference letters; 12-24 month cash-flow projection; enforceable distribution agreements with MENA/EU/NA buyers; ETA tax card; and audited evidence of the physical production line for robotic floor cleaners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: AML/CFT concern: rapid succession of inbound equity transfers followed within six months by outbound 'trade payments' to related-party suppliers lacking shipping evidence or customs declarations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CBE capital-entry certificate for each inward tranche; ACI/NAFEZA pre-shipment registrations; bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, and customs export declarations on both the Egyptian and Chinese sides; LC/MT103 records; transfer-pricing study; and statutory-audit confirmations that funds were deployed into robotic-vacuum production lines and component inventory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-finance screening flag: requests for unsecured 180-day LC tenors or discounted export bills payable through a shell-like intermediary in a third jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OEM/ODM manufacturing contracts; purchase orders from blue-chip retailers or distributors; product safety certifications (CE, FCC, IEC/EN 60335); ultimate-beneficial-ownership confirmation of the intermediary; prior delivery track record; and execution of the bank's standard export-finance non-avoidance undertaking.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: (1) the non-resident shareholder instructs its overseas bank to execute SWIFT MT103/MT202 to EG_LLC's USD FCA at the receiving Egyptian tier-1 bank; field 70 must read 'EQUITY CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION EG_LLC / Companies Law 4/2022'; (2) the receiving bank validates the LLC's GAFI file and post-incorporation shareholders register, classifies the transfer under BPM6 direct-investment equity (FDI equity) using the local CBE purpose code for capital inflows, and issues the CBE capital-entry certificate on the same value date; (3) for larger equity tranches, the bank requests the general-assembly resolution and a capital-deployment plan covering robotic-vacuum production equipment, tooling, and working capital; (4) any EGP conversion takes place at the unified interbank rate and is reported in the bank's daily CBE FX position statement. The capital-entry certificate is the controlling document for all future dividend and capital repatriation and must be preserved in the treasury archive.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Two compliant clearing rails govern EG_LLC's supplier payments: TT Wire and Commercial LC. (1) TT Wire (SWIFT MT103) is used for supplier invoices below USD 50,000 and for repeat low-risk vendors; the narrative must reference the proforma invoice number and ACI/NAFEZA import registration (ACR number) to permit Egyptian customs release; settlement is effected in USD through New York or London correspondents or in CNH through offshore renminbi clearing. (2) Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700, UCP600/ISBP745) is the mandatory rail for bulk component shipments from PRC/HK/Taiwan exceeding USD 50,000; the LLC issues irrevocable sight or deferred-payment LCs (up to 180 days tenor) with a 15-30% cash margin, and confirmation by a top-tier PRC or Hong Kong bank is recommended to eliminate documentary-discrepancy and transit risk. All outbound settlements must be matched against CBE-eligible export proceeds held in the LLC's USD FCA, thereby avoiding EGP liquidity strain and preserving the bank's available FX allocation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP FX forward (maximum 180-day tenor) for hedging USD-denominated trade payables or export receivables, subject to underlying trade documentation and CBE bank eligibility.
USD/EGP cross-currency swap with a CBE-authorized bank to match long-tenor capex financing (robotic-vacuum production lines) against future export-receipt cash flows.
FX collar or purchased-option structures (call spread on USD/EGP) offered by CBE-licensed derivatives desks for downside protection on USD export receipts.

Offshore EGP Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) executable by non-resident hedge counterparties or the Egyptian bank's overseas branch; resident EG_LLC may not book speculative onshore NDFs under CBE prudential FX rules.
USD/CNH non-deliverable forward or swap for yuan-invoiced supplier payables, settled in USD through the same Egyptian trade-finance line.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: GAFI Annual Fee and Commercial Registry Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Commercial Registry Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January for companies with a 31 December fiscal year-end; off-calendar fiscal-year companies must settle before the commercial registration anniversary date. The GAFI annual fee and Commercial Registry renewal are consolidated in one electronic payment through the GAFI e-window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge of 2% per month applied to the unpaid annual dues; the company status is flagged as non-compliant in the Commercial Registry, blocking customs clearance, exporter registration, and notarial bank operations. Non-renewal for 12 consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off by GAFI after a formal final notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation and Updated Register of Beneficial Owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI - Companies Compliance and AML Unit (electronic UBO filing portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the same filing window as the GAFI renewal (due 31 January for calendar-year companies); any share transfer creating, changing, or terminating a 25% or greater beneficial ownership must be filed within 30 days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of EGP 5,000 to EGP 200,000 for late or inaccurate UBO declarations; suspension of the affected shareholder's voting rights and dividend entitlement; GAFI refuses the annual compliance certificate until corrected, blocking SWIFT LC operations and TT wire transfers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Corporate Income Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 4 months after the fiscal year-end (30 April for a 31 December year-end). The return is accompanied by the audited financial statements, CIT reconciliation schedules, payroll schedules, and export documentation substantiating applicable exemptions or zero-rated transactions.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the assessed tax (minimum EGP 500) plus monthly delay interest of 1.5% on the unpaid balance; the ETA may issue an estimated assessment and attach bank accounts; fraudulent non-filing results in criminal fines and imprisonment under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 67 of 2021.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements, Auditor's Report, and Minutes of the Annual General Assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Assembly of Shareholders at the company registered office; records produced upon request to GAFI and ETA inspectors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end (by 30 June for a 31 December year-end). The statutory auditor's report must be issued before the assembly, and the signed financial statements and minutes must be retained in the statutory register at the registered office.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors are jointly and severally liable for non-observance under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended; fines of EGP 5,000 to EGP 20,000 per director apply, and GAFI may appoint the auditor at company expense where the company fails to do so.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Wage Declaration and Social Insurance Final Account
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - Employer Registration Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days from the fiscal year-end (by 28 February for a 31 December year-end); the final account reconciles the monthly payroll contribution declarations for all insured Egyptian workers of the robotic vacuum manufacturing plant.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly delay interest on unpaid contributions under Social Insurance Law No. 148 of 2019, with administrative fines assessed per insured employee per month of delay; persistent default blocks issuance of the NOSI clearance certificate required for government contracts and the transfer of proceeds.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Egyptian LLC must appoint an independent statutory auditor licensed by the Egyptian Accountants and Auditors Syndicate, regardless of turnover. A full certified audit is mandatory for all companies other than micro-enterprises under MSME Law No. 93 of 2018, i.e., where annual turnover exceeds EGP 1 million (approx. USD 20,000). The ISIC 2750 robotic vacuum OEM, being an active manufacturing entity with import/export operations, is unconditionally subject to a full statutory audit of its annual financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by the Ministry of Investment apply as local GAAP; EAS is substantively converged with IFRS for recognition, measurement, and presentation; IFRS as issued by the IASB is mandatory for listed companies and FRA-regulated financial institutions. The statutory audit is conducted under Egyptian Auditing Standards, which are a direct codification of the International Standards on Auditing (ISA).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under GAFI Decree No. 22 of 2020 and AML Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended by Law No. 36 of 2020), the LLC must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners identifying every individual owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, 25% or more of the shares or voting rights, or exercising ultimate control. The register is confirmed annually within the GAFI renewal filing due by 31 January. Any share transfer that changes beneficial ownership must be reported to GAFI within 30 days and before the registration of the transferee in the Register of Members; GAFI blocks issuance of the annual compliance certificate until the update is made.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share transfers, share types, and pledged shares)
Register of Directors and Senior Officers
Minute Book of General Assemblies and Board Resolutions
Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO Register per GAFI Decree No. 22 of 2020)
Commercial books, ledgers, vouchers, and audit correspondence (retained 7 years)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 150 - USD 600 per year (typical Cairo market range for registered office services, GAFI correspondence handling, and annual compliance secretarial support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 900 - USD 3,500 per year (typical certified audit fee for an Egyptian mid-market manufacturing LLC with annual turnover between EGP 20 million and EGP 200 million, excluding tax audit defense)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 can reduce CIT to 11.25% for qualifying new industrial manufacturing projects (including home appliance production) operating in designated governorates outside Greater Cairo and Alexandria for an initial 5-year period. Suez Canal Economic Zone licensed activities can benefit from a special 5% rate on commercial and industrial profits. No statutory full tax holiday applies to ordinary LLCs, but targeted ministerial approvals and free-zone exemptions may reduce the effective rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 18 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-Tax portal. E-invoices and e-receipt records must be digitally transmitted to the ETA where the LLC exceeds the income threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end. For a calendar-year LLC, the deadline is 30 April. Quarterly provisional CIT instalments are payable in 3 installments before the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, Egyptian Tax Card number, Commercial Registration number, Industrial Licensing number, registered office, email, and telephone.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Egyptian tax agent's name and Tax Card number; attach a notarised and legalised power of attorney appointing that agent for service and filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenues from Egyptian-source sales of robotic vacuum appliance units, spare parts, and maintenance contracts during the tax period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If sales are routed through an Egyptian permanent establishment (agent, warehouse, or fixed base), include them fully. If no PE exists under Law 91/2005 Articles 31-34, state zero and attach treaty/POEM analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold: imported components, battery packs, sensors, motors, plastic moulding, labour, factory overhead, depreciation on production equipment, and freight.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If goods are purchased from a related foreign parent or OEM, adjust the price to the arm's-length price and attach a transfer pricing summary if aggregate related-party imports exceed the EGP filing threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General and administrative expenses: salaries, rent, utilities, internet, insurance, professional fees, marketing, and ordinary repairs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign head-office management fees are deductible only at actual cost plus a reasonable mark-up and only where supported by service contracts from the Egyptian LLC. Deductible royalties must have tax withheld at the appropriate treaty rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-backs and non-deductible items: depreciation exceeding statutory rates, fines, penalties, bribes, entertainment above the cap, and foreign taxes paid on Egyptian income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back withholding taxes borne on behalf of the foreign parent, excessive amortization of intra-group IP, and interest disallowed under any thin-capitalisation restriction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit or loss after deducting prior-year tax losses carried forward within the 5-year statutory window.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses incurred by the Egyptian PE are not available to the foreign parent; compute the cumulative loss carryforward schedule and attach it.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT calculated at 22.5%, reduced by Investment Law incentives, then less quarterly prepayments and final balance due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the ministerial incentive approval and the computation of the 11.25% rate, if applicable. Final balance must be settled by bank transfer to the ETA account before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of intercompany transactions: nature, amount, counterparty jurisdiction, transfer pricing method, and confirmation of Local File / Master File preparation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parent must state whether the Egyptian entity is included in the group Master File and CbCR. Non-disclosure triggers an immediate ETA TP audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fine ranges from EGP 500 to EGP 5,000. A monthly late-payment surcharge of 2% on the unpaid tax applies for each month or part of a month, capped at 100% of the tax due. Incorrect or incomplete submissions attract a penalty of up to 20% of the additional tax; false returns trigger double tax and criminal referral.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross cash or in-kind dividends paid to foreign shareholders, unless a tax treaty provides a lower rate (commonly 5-15%).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the foreign shareholder must submit a formal application to the ETA before the distribution, attach an original Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the treaty country and legalised with Arabic translation, complete a beneficial ownership declaration, and obtain the ETA's written approval on the reduced rate. If approval is granted after payment, a refund claim can be filed within 3 years from the end of the relevant tax period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 20% on gross royalties and 20% on gross interest paid to foreign related parties. Under Egypt's DTAs, treaty rates range from 0-15% for interest and 10-15% for industrial royalties, subject to beneficial ownership and anti-abuse analysis.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10,000,000 aggregate related-party transactions (goods, services, intangibles, or financing) triggers the mandatory Local File. Master File is required where the Egyptian LLC belongs to a multinational group with consolidated revenue of at least EGP 100,000,000. CbCR filing applies when group consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 20,000,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations, but domestic substance is tested through the place of effective management doctrine, the arm's-length principle, and the General Anti-Abuse Rule under Article 103 of Law 91/2005. An Egyptian LLC manufacturing robotic vacuum appliances must evidence real operations in Egypt: board meetings held in Egypt, engineering and assembly activity, employees covered by Egyptian social insurance, inventory, and actual production. A shell with no real substance will be disregarded and transactions recharacterised.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating Egyptian-source sales, using fake invoices for component purchases, or shifting robotic vacuum appliance profits through a non-resident intermediary with no business purpose.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment from 3 to 7 years; fine equal to double the evaded tax; 2% monthly late-payment surcharge on unpaid tax; commercial registration cancellation; tax lien over the LLC's assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax where they directed or facilitated the evasion. Courts may issue travel bans, freeze personal assets, and order confiscation of properties purchased with hidden profits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare a Local File or Master File, applying a non-approved method without economic justification, or pricing intra-group royalty payments above the arm's-length range.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP recharacterisation plus additional tax at 22.5%, 2% monthly delay surcharge, and administrative penalty of up to 20% of the adjustment. Wilful manipulation can be prosecuted as tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the return with knowledge of false TP certifications are personally liable for the additional tax and penalties. Egyptian courts may pierce the veil and render a personal travel ban until settlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends to the foreign parent without withholding the 10% statutory tax, or without obtaining the DTA-approved reduced withholding clearance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of unpaid WHT plus a penalty equal to 100% of the unpaid amount and 2% monthly overdue surcharge; ETA may attach the LLC's local bank accounts and receivables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who vote a dividend while withholding tax is unpaid are personally liable to the extent of the distribution, especially where the LLC is insolvent, and may face travel restrictions pending payment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating an Egyptian LLC that holds a bank account and invoices but has no machinery, employees, power consumption, or actual manufacturing activity in Egypt, used to route robotic vacuum products and shift profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation under Article 103 GAAR; disallowance of all deductions; assessment on a deemed profit basis for up to 5 years; penalty equal to double the tax due; possible compulsory dissolution under the Companies Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and shareholding nominees are jointly and severally liable for 100% of the unpaid tax and fines; may be disqualified from board service for 5 years and referred to public prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering through Tax-Offshore Flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using over-invoiced imports of robotic vacuum components to transfer funds to a tax-haven entity, or laundering cash proceeds through cryptocurrency and offshore shell bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 80 of 2002, imprisonment from 3 to 15 years and a fine ranging from EGP 100,000 to EGP 5,000,000; mandatory confiscation of laundered funds and related assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Regulators may freeze personal assets, issue travel bans, and impose 5-10 year directorship disqualification. Directors can be personally ordered to forfeit unexplained wealth connected to the laundering scheme.
